poetryFrame.leftVertical: WE WERE WAY UP TONIGHT, BREATHING IN THE SMOKE AND THE MUSIC
poetryFrame.rightVertical: THIS FEELING IS MORE THAN JUST A SONG; IT'S MY NEW REALITY
poetryFrame.bottomLine: YOUR VOICE CARRIES ME THROUGH ALL THE DARKNESS.
sonnetLines: The fear that woke me fades to dust,
A whisper caught in smoke and gold.
I shed the habit of distrust,
No longer will the sad notes sting,
The reckless joy the moments bring,
Washing out the doubt and pain.
We dance upon a fragile height,
Where amber spills on indigo blue.
My heart finds its forever true.
This melody is where I belong,
